entities.summary: The Kamenny Island Theatre is a wooden theatre on the grounds of the Kamennoostrovsky Palace, Kamenny Island, Saint Petersburg, Russia. It is the only surviving wooden theatre in St. Petersburg, and one of the few remaining in Europe. The theatre is a world heritage site protected by UNESCO. Kamenny Island Theatre is a theatre building in Europe, established in 1826. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
